title: Teacher Education, Licensure & GES Induction
description: The sequential roadmap to become a licensed teacher in Ghana—from admission to public Colleges of Education (PRINCOF) to sitting the National Teaching Council (NTC) licensure examination and GES induction.

steps.title: Apply via PRINCOF Centralised Admission Portal
steps.why: All 46 public Colleges of Education in Ghana process B.Ed degree applications through the centralised portal managed by the Principals of Colleges of Education.
steps.do_this_when: During the annual colleges of education application cycle.

options.label: Colleges of Education Centralised Admission Portal
options.notes: Central application portal for public teacher education colleges.

options.label: Accra College of Education Application Procedure
options.notes: Accra College of Education specific admission guidelines.

options.label: Wesley College of Education Admission Notice
options.notes: Kumasi teacher education campus admissions notice.

steps.title: Register for Ghana Teacher Licensure Examination (GTLE)
steps.why: The Education Regulatory Bodies Act 2020 (Act 1023) mandates that all trained teachers pass the National Teaching Council licensure exams to be certified to teach.
steps.do_this_when: In final year of teacher training or upon graduation.

options.label: Teacher Portal Ghana (TPG) Licensure Application
options.notes: Official National Teaching Council portal for teacher licensing and exams.

steps.title: Register for Ghana Education Service (GES) Posting
steps.why: Newly certified teachers register with GES to receive school postings, IPPD payroll ID numbers, and staff appointment letters.

options.label: GES Teacher Registration & Recruitment Portal
options.notes: Official recruitment and regional posting portal for licensed teachers.
